knowledge_cards.claim: Linear modal late-reverb models require a domain boundary for nonlinear or strongly spectrally processed IRs.
Room-reverb descriptors and user controls may be correlated; slider independence is not causal independence.
The reported corpus predicts modal density less reliably than damping, so uncertainty must be band-specific.
Regression fit and corpus placement do not establish audible preference or realism without listener evaluation.
EQ/compressor order changes compressor-detector exposure and can be isolated as one controlled mixing factor.
Whole-subgroup and individual parallel-compression sends are contextual alternatives, not universal defaults.

rule_candidates.applicability: Project-owned synthetic reverb prototype on a dry or compact drum section
rule_candidates.change: Vary only normalized early/late balance while freezing all other reverb, routing, width, EQ, and dry-balance factors
rule_candidates.range_origin: Paper's p5-p95 corpus mapping, not a production recommendation
rule_candidates.verification: Endpoint inspection plus randomized BS.1770 loudness-matched A/B and Dmitry preference
rule_candidates.cancel_when: Preference disappears after matching or artifacts, masking, image collapse, or headroom loss appear

rule_candidates.applicability: A deliberately retained hard gate truncates a snare that should sound larger than the recorded room
rule_candidates.change: Add one ambience/reverb path or one sustain-restoration stage, without simultaneously changing the gate
rule_candidates.range_origin: The video's 1 s EMT 250 decay is an example only, not a project range
rule_candidates.verification: Randomized loudness-matched section-context A/B; solo only as diagnostic
rule_candidates.cancel_when: Smearing, excess bleed, unstable image, or loudness-only preference occurs

experiments.question: Does pre-reverb feed compression improve rock-drum density after loudness matching without weakening attack or increasing cymbal wash?
experiments.material: Project-owned representative verse and chorus drum sections
experiments.variant_a: Current reverb send and return; no pre-reverb compressor
experiments.variant_b: Same routing, send, reverb, filters, decay, pre-delay, width, and return level; one pre-reverb compressor enabled
experiments.loudness_matching: Trim return contribution so full-mix excerpts match within 0.1 LU integrated under BS.1770; verify peaks and true peak separately
experiments.success: Randomized preference for B in both sections with no protected-quality regression and no loudness-only advantage
experiments.cancel: Inconsistent preference after matching, added pumping or wash, or any protected-quality regression
